title: Vote to release Apache Iceberg Rust 0.11.0 RC1
summary: Danny Jones called a vote on Apache Iceberg Rust 0.11.0 RC1 (tag v0.11.0-rc.1). Two non-binding +1 votes came in after verification on macOS and Linux; one verifier saw a flaky REST catalog rename test caused by a locked SQLite test fixture and did not consider it a blocker. Kevin Liu voted -1 because the candidate cannot be published: the iceberg crate depends on the new iceberg-property-macro crate, which has iceberg as a versioned dev-dependency, so cargo publish fails for both. He recalled that the same circular dependency after the 0.5.0 vote forced a 0.5.1 release, and opened a fix that also adds a cargo publish dry-run check to CI. He also noted that make test from the tarball fails at docker-up because the Hive image's apt repository has expired, which a change on main fixes. Danny Jones agreed it is a blocker, voted -1 and said he would prepare RC2.

positions.stance: The candidate cannot be published because of a circular dependency between iceberg and iceberg-property-macro, so it should be fixed and a new RC cut.
The candidate verified on Linux; a flaky REST catalog rename test caused by a locked SQLite test fixture is not a blocker.
The publishing problem is a blocker for the release and RC2 will follow.

outcome.note: RC1 was abandoned in favor of an RC2: after two non-binding +1 votes, kevinjqliu voted -1 over a crate circular dependency that blocks publishing, and the release manager agreed with a non-binding -1. No formal result message was sent.

why_it_matters: A cargo publish dry-run check in CI is being added so that unpublishable crate dependencies are caught on pull requests.
